title: Amex vs Chase: My Wallet Is the Final Boss
description:
Dave gets caught between rival credit-card perks, points, and a very uninvited fee. Original stick-figure comedy about matching a card to your real spending—not chasing the shiny perks.

This is a fictional entertainment scenario, not a comparison of current Amex or Chase offers. No current fees, reward rates, eligibility, or benefit entitlements are represented. No sponsorship or affiliate offer is included.

Next in the series: Your Credit Card Has DLC.

#Shorts #CreditCards #PersonalFinance
transcript: Stop attacking my wallet! Two cards. Still no budget. Watch the shiny perks. That's where Dave stops reading. Lounge snacks? Finally, a financial plan with tiny sandwiches. The snacks arrived. So did the fee. Dave only invited one. I'll pay with points! Why does this button say bad idea? Plot twist: the winning card fits your life. The cape is optional. I'm choosing a budget. Does it come with tiny sandwiches?
